title: Longer Than the Cake
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：comfort　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 comfort 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 my grandmother ① comforted a neighbour who had lost nothing she could name, and she said the comforting was the whole of the visit. The ② comfort, meaning the words and not the cake, arrived before the cake and stayed longer; comfort, she said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it stays.

Every ③ comfort in that street had the same shape, and the ④ comfort at the end, meaning the one she kept for the bad nights and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever asked for twice. Comfort, my mother said, is nine parts staying and one part somebody willing to sit; my grandmother said the staying is the part that outlasts the cake.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ comfort was the whole of the chair, meaning the softness and not the words. The ⑥ comfort, meaning the softness and not any of that, is the only thing in a chair that everybody sinks into and nobody mentions; comfort, he said, is either something you say or the only word that means both a word and a chair. She said the chair is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ comfort had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about who had sat longest. The ⑧ comfort of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in November, was one visit and thirty years of sitting; comfort, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stay. He said the staying was never mentioned.

The ⑨ comfort I remember is the one at the end, which was offered in 1978 and is still described as the longest in the street. A ⑩ comfort, my mother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being given; every comfort, she said, is a staying that has agreed to look like a word. She said the staying was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 安慰（指那一句安慰的话本身，与那块蛋糕相对）
C. 固定搭配：comfort a neighbour 安慰邻居
D. n. 安慰（指那条街上每一次）
E. n. 安慰（指末尾那一句）
F. n. 舒适；安逸（指椅子的柔软，物质层面）
G. n. 安慰（指信里提到的那一句）
H. n. 安逸生活；舒适（抽象总称）

items.q: comforted a neighbour who had lost nothing she could name
The comfort, meaning the words and not the cake
comfort was the whole of the chair
the comfort had become a line in a letter
The comfort of the whole thing
A comfort, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: comfort a neighbour 意为“安慰邻居”，1960 年祖母安慰了一位说不出自己失去了什么的邻居。
comfort 意为“安慰”，指那一句安慰的话本身而不是那块蛋糕，它比蛋糕到得早、留得久。
comfort 指那条街上每一次安慰，每一次都是同样的样子。
comfort 指末尾那一句（她留给那些难熬的夜晚的那一句），是唯一有人要过两次的。
comfort 意为“舒适、安逸”，父亲说舒适就是那把椅子的全部，指的是柔软而不是那些话。
comfort 为物质层面用法，指椅子的柔软而不是那些话，是椅子中人人都陷进去、却无人提起的东西。
comfort 意为“安慰”，指信里提到的那一句，到 1972 年这句安慰成了信里的一行。
comfort 意为“安逸生活、舒适”，祖母十一月写道，整件事的舒适是一次探望三十年的坐下陪着。
comfort 意为“安慰”，我记得的是末尾那一句，1978 年给出，至今仍被说成全街最长的。
comfort 为抽象总称，母亲说一句安慰是唯一会因为被给予而变好的东西。
